content.about: Czechia is a landlocked country in Central Europe, with hills, forests and old castles. Its capital, Prague, has a medieval astronomical clock and many bridges. It is known for glassmaking and beer. Czechs drink more beer per person than any other nation.

standout.text: Prague Castle is one of the largest ancient castle complexes in the world.

didYouKnow: Prague's astronomical clock is the oldest still working in the world.
The word "robot" first appeared in a Czech play in 1920.
Czechia has more than 2,000 castles and chateaux.
